newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Amcor crumples on subdued outlook.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Amcor crumples on subdued outlook.

text.p: Shares in paper and packaging group Amcor Ltd fell 13 cents or 1.5 percent to A$8.36 in active Thursday afternoon trade after reporting a sharply lower first half profit and issuing a subdued profit outlook.
Analysts and brokers said the A$140.6 million net profit before abnormals for the half, down from A$213.5 million in the previous comparable period, was at the bottom end of market expectations.
But it was Amcor's bearish comments about continued margin pressure and a flat market for the rest of 1996/97 that had most disappointed investors, brokers said.
"If you look at the statement, the outlook wasn't exactly gangbusters," said one senior Sydney broker.
"There may well be some trimming of full year forecasts going on," the broker said.

Earlier, Amcor said it did not expect currently difficult trading conditions to improve in the second half of 1996/97 ending June 30 and said margin pressure would continue to affect results in Australia and New Zealand.
